items.name: North America
items.fact: Includes Canada, the United States, Mexico, and Central America / the Caribbean.

items.name: South America
items.fact: Home to the Amazon rainforest and the Andes, the world’s longest mountain range.

items.name: Europe
items.fact: A peninsula of Eurasia with dozens of countries packed into a relatively small area.

items.name: Africa
items.fact: The second-largest continent; the Sahara is the largest hot desert on Earth.

items.name: Asia
items.fact: The largest continent by land and population — from Turkey to Japan.

items.name: Oceania
items.fact: Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific island nations of Melanesia, Micronesia, and Polynesia.

items.name: Antarctica
items.fact: The coldest, driest, and windiest continent — covered almost entirely by ice.
